title: Danger Dead Ahead!
front_description: With the Jedi in hot pursuit, Zam Wesell heads into Coruscant's industrial sector, weaving her craft between massive columns of name. As both vehicles zoom through a refinery, they must dodge deadly electrical bolts that crackle between the couplings. Anakin seems to thrive on this high-speed excitement, much to the flustered dismay of his mentor Obi-Wan.
back_description: Erik Tiemens' breathtaking production painting of Coruscant's power refinery.
